opening.argument: The video presents a low-barrier offer of a free $250 Victoria's Secret gift card and directs viewers to an external website as the means to obtain it. The title promises, “Free $250 Victorias Secret Gift Card!”, while the description says, “In this video I'll show you exactly how to get a free $250 Victrias Secret Gift Card!” and supplies a separate web address. Sampled frames reinforce the same connection by repeating the gift-card offer, explaining that the video will show how to get one, and displaying the website address alongside Victoria's Secret branding. The records do not establish the website's behavior, any information or payment requirement, card validity, or official brand authorization, but they do show a promotional promise tied to an external destination.
